title: Valkyria Chronicles
shortDescription: Squad 7 defends the principality of Gallia in an alternate 1935 Europa using the BLiTZ real-time tactical system.
historicalSignificance: Introduced the CANVAS watercolor engine and revolutionized tactical role-playing by merging strategy with third-person action.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
